## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Silla-dynasty commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng* by **Taehyŏn** 太賢 ([太賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%AA%E8%B3%A2)) — the major Silla Yogācāra scholar of the 8th century. *古迹* "old traces" indicates that the commentary preserves earlier exegetical traditions; the genre is a compendium that gathers and synthesises prior commentaries.

**Abstract**

Taehyŏn's *Fànwǎngjīng gǔjì jì* is one of the **three principal Silla commentaries** on the *Fànwǎng jīng*, alongside [義寂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E5%AF%82) Ŭijŏk's *Púsàjièběn shū* ([KR6k0082](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0082)) and [元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89) Wǒnhyo's *Fànwǎngjīng púsàjièběn sījì* ([KR6k0090](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0090)). The text presents a synthetic Yogācāra-Cí'ēn 慈恩 reading drawing on Tang scholarship while preserving distinctly Korean exegetical traditions. Like Ŭijŏk's commentary, it is included in the Taishō canon as representative East Asian commentary literature.
